findings.rationale: Selective verification evaluated all 10 canary-selected targets and recorded unanimous agreement without material disagreements, confirming blind escalations and adjudication were not triggered.

All required identities and candidates across both families are disposed exactly once, citations are strictly local and subject-anchored, and unestablished operating-identity dimensions are preserved via explicit gaps.
The compiler release preview correctly preserves the provisional activations, containing-industry relationships, and product-mapping semantics defined in the verified primary payload.
